table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	Notes.NoteCode,   
	Notes.VoucherCode,
	Accounts.AliasName,
	AccountName=Accounts.Name,   
	TransferTo=(SELECT A.Name FROM Accounts A WHERE A.AccCode = Notes.BankAccCode),
	Notes.IssueDate,   
	Notes.DueDate,   
	Notes.Amount,   
	UnAppliedAmt = ISNULL(Notes.Amount - ISNULL((SELECT SUM(amt) FROM NotesDetail WHERE NotesDetail.NoteCode = Notes.NoteCode), 0), 0),
	Notes.BankName,   
	Notes.DocumentNumber,   
	Notes.Remarks,   
	Notes.Finalized,   
	Notes.FinalizedDate,   
	Notes.Posted,   
	PostedBy = (SELECT Users.UserName FROM users WHERE Users.UserCode = notes.postedby),
	Notes.PostDate,   
	Notes.DocumentNumber,
	UserName=(SELECT Users.UserName FROM users WHERE Users.UserCode = notes.salesmancode),
	Notes.AccCode,
	Notes.BankAccCode
FROM
	Notes, Accounts  
WHERE
	Notes.AccCode = Accounts.AccCode AND
	Notes.NoteCatCode = 2
